content.short: Upshift is an institutional-grade DeFi yield platform providing automated strategies via ERC-4626 vaults on Arbitrum.
content.description: Upshift is a premier decentralized asset management protocol designed to simplify access to sophisticated financial strategies for both retail and institutional participants. Spun out of the August Digital prime brokerage, the platform offers a curated selection of non-custodial ERC-4626 vaults that automate complex DeFi operations, such as delta-neutral hedging and optimized liquidity provision. This allows users to earn consistent yields from top-tier protocols like Aave and Morpho. Upshift focuses on professional-grade transparency and security, having undergone multiple audits.
content.meta: Upshift provides automated DeFi yield strategies and institutional-grade ERC-4626 vaults. Discover Upshift and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Explorer.
